report_deck: Measured dev split results for hosted-large, hosted-redacted, and local extractor configs at IoU 0.5.

configs.label: Hosted redacted
configs.description: Same hosted model after PII redaction and span remapping.

configs.label: Local
configs.description: Local qwen2.5:7b run on full text.

headline_callout.label: Superseded reported open, hosted-large
headline_callout.text: The hosted-large run reports 2 of 14 matched superseded commitments as still open.

deltas.label: Redaction cost
statements: Recall changes by -40.2 percentage points and F1 by -34.3 percentage points.
Cost-weighted error changes by -2.81 per thread; the lower cost is driven by silence after provider and parse failures, not a better extractor.

deltas.label: Model scale cost
statements: Recall changes by +32.7 percentage points and F1 by +24.8 percentage points.
Cost-weighted error changes by +1.55 per thread.

additional_findings: Off-thread counterparties: 11/273 delegation targets never sent a message.

history.leak: Real organisation names appeared in early threads.
history.fix: Replaced them with roles and added the no-real-organisations rule.
Clarified that the acceptor's own commitment wins when it exists.

history.leak: The negative-thread cue test was English-centric.
history.fix: Moved from literal keywords to construction families across English, Hindi-English, and Tamil-English.

history.leak: Deadline-certainty distribution shifted between batch 0 and batch 1.
history.fix: Audited sampled loops, corrected 3 labels, and recorded the remaining shift as thread-writing drift.
